import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p = params
    a = p[0] + p[1]/t + p[2]*t + p[3]*t**2
    K = p[4] + p[5]*t
    n = p[6] + p[7]*t
    return -a/(1 + (np.abs(A)/K)**n)

import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p = params
    base = p[0] + p[1]/t + p[2]*t + p[3]*np.exp(-t)
    amp = p[4] + p[5]*t + p[9]*t**2
    S = 1 - np.exp(-p[6]*np.abs(A)**p[7]*t**p[8])
    return base + amp*S
